person: Reggie Banks is 61, a retired grocery-chain accounts payable clerk who now works three days a week as the finance person for a small snack brand selling through UNFI and KeHE. He has macular degeneration, so he works at 175% zoom with a high-contrast theme and loses his place in wide tables. Each month the deductions outrun him, and the brand writes off what it can't prove. The founder, Dana, wants one number: how much of the short-pay is real. He wants every total shown with the lines under it so he can add them himself.
stated_up_front: Athena, I have September's UNFI and KeHE short-pays to sort through and I can't keep up with them. Go through each deduction, tell me which ones are real and which we should fight, and show me the lines so I can add them up myself.

facts.about: Total short-pay for September across both distributors
facts.truth: $14,860 total: $9,420 from UNFI and $5,440 from KeHE

facts.about: Number of deductions to review this month
Approved promo rate on the fall endcap with the Pacific Natural chain
facts.truth: $1.20 off per case, shown on the broker's September deal sheet
8% of invoice, which Reggie accepts as valid per the agreement

facts.about: Where the broker's deal sheets and agreement live
facts.truth: A Dropbox folder called 'Brand Docs', with a subfolder per retailer; the broker is Marcus at Tallgrass Brokerage
Effective Sept 15 on the 12-count bars, but the brand billed the new price on invoices dated Sept 10

facts.about: Free fill promised in the agreement
facts.truth: One free case per 20 on new-item launches, which the Oat Crunch launch should have covered

facts.about: Oldest deduction he knows of that is open
facts.truth: A $212 UNFI shortage from a September 2025 invoice that he suspects is past the twelve-month window

facts.about: Which warehouse carries receiver notes on its proofs of delivery
facts.truth: The Stockton warehouse portal shows receiver notes; he has not checked the others
A plain list, one deduction per line, large dark text on white, with a running total he can add up; no wide tables
Dana says don't chase anything under $40 unless the same code keeps repeating

unknowns: What the exact dispute deadline is for each distributor, and whether it counts from the invoice date or the deduction date
What several of the numeric deduction codes on the KeHE side mean
Whether KeHE's advanced search shows items older than the standard view
Whether any warehouses other than Stockton record receiver notes on their proofs of delivery
